mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% over the past month signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly unemployment rate below 4.5% for the past quarter indicates a strong labor market, fostering confidence and positive long-term equity valuations, leading to 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If 60-day returns are negative despite UNRATE remaining below 4.5%, or if the rate rises above 4.5% in the subsequent month.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly billings growth (GDPC1) exceeding 2% MoM for the past month signals robust demand, accelerating corporate earnings and driving positive short-term S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative when GDPC1 growth is above 2%, or if growth reverses in the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the INDPRO index above 104.1 (previous month's value) reflects expanding production capacity, boosting corporate profits and supporting positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns negative despite INDPRO rising, or the rise is not sustained beyond the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in UNRATE below 4.5% and rising PAYEMS (labor force participation) above 140k persons indicate a robust labor market, amplifying investor confidence and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative despite UNRATE <4.5% and PAYEMS >140k, or if either proxy moves out of the specified range.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for the past month), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate reduced growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% for the past month
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive when FEDFUNDS are in tightening, or if the tightening does not occur as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers immediate negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns due to anticipated rate hikes reducing growth expectations and equity valuations.
failure_condition: 5-day returns positive when FEDFUNDS cross above 4.5%, or if the rate remains below 4.5% after the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in quarterly billings (GDPC1) and RSAFS (retail sales) exceeding their respective 2% MoM thresholds signals robust demand across sectors, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns negative despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising above 2% MoM, or if one proxy does not meet its threshold while the other does.
